name: Mahlah
overview: Mahlah was one of the five daughters of Zelophehad, a man from the tribe of Manasseh who died without sons. In Numbers 27, Mahlah and her sisters approached Moses and the leaders at the tabernacle to request an inheritance, arguing that their father's name should not be lost among his family simply because he had no male heirs. Moses presented their case before the Lord, leading to special legislation that allowed daughters to inherit when no sons were present, demonstrating God's justice and provision within the community.
